biography.plain_text: Thomas J. Lyons Jr. was an American hotel developer who founded Tidewater Hotels & Resorts and Coastal Hospitality Associates. His businesses developed and managed hotels across Virginia and North Carolina. After selling Tidewater and eight Marriott properties, he retained ten hotels and established a new company to take over their management.

long_biography.plain_text:
Hotel developer Thomas Lyons studied philosophy at Georgetown University and opened the Cellar Door music club while still a student. The intimate Georgetown venue presented emerging performers across several genres. His interest in buildings came from his architect father, who designed parts of Canterbury School, where Lyons had been a pupil.

That architectural interest also shaped his public service. During seventeen years as a Norfolk Academy trustee, he chaired its Buildings and Grounds Committee through a substantial campus transformation. He and his wife, Joan, supported education and the arts together. An annual performance in their names brings professional musicians to Norfolk Academy through its partnership with the Virginia Arts Festival.
